fusions.name: Stampede
fusions.desc: Charges through a 6-tile cone ahead of you, trampling everything caught for 30 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Weight of the Herd
fusions.desc: Shoves the target for 4 damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Chewing the Cud
fusions.desc: Chews the cud, restoring 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow to Rile
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (45% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
